entries.name: fated pairs
entries.content: fated pairs are alphas and omegas who are perfect matches for each other. after fated pairs meet, they can't live without each other, otherwise they'll suffer unbearable pain and heartache. if a fated pair tries to mate with another alpha or omega, their entire body will be in unbearable pain until they stop. there's only a 0.01% chance of finding your fated mate.

entries.name: pheromones
entries.content: pheromones are the scent emitted by alphas, omegas. pheromones can vary in scent depending on the persons mood; for example, if an omega is in heat, their pheromones become sweeter and more alluring to alphas, or if they’re distressed, scared, etc., their pheromones will sour and become pungent. alphas scents can become more intense depending on their moods to enforce submission or to show they aren’t a threat to an omega.

entries.name: scenting
entries.content: alphas or omegas rubs their wrists or neck on another person or object to mark them/it with their scent. scenting can serve comfort purposes, such as soothing omegas during their heats or calming down a feral alpha. It can also be used as a means of claiming another person without using a mating bite. scenting is a very intimate and takes a lot of trust.

entries.name: mating
entries.content: mating bites are claimed bites on the neck scent glands of alphas and omegas. people can be bitten in different places, but a bond will only form if the bite is on the neck scent glands. if an alpha or omega has a mating bite, they are bonded and become mates. mating bites, particularly on omegas, are highly sensitive. if the mating bite is touched by someone other than their mate, it will be painful or sensitive to the touch. However, if the bite is touched by their mate, it will be incredibly pleasurable.

entries.name: rut and heat
entries.content: alphas have ruts, characterized by a 3 to 5-day period where they become overly aggressive and territorial, during this time, alphas also feel an increased urge to breed with an omega, more than usual, ruts can make alphas irritable and potentially dangerous to be around. omegas have heats, month-long periods lasting a week, where they become excessively aroused and desire mating and breeding with an alpha, if not fulfilled, omegas experience intense pain and a heightened body temperature. omegas can become incoherent during heats and require care from an alpha.
